title: PMKS: Co-Designing Distributed Networking and Multi-Tier Storage for Ultra-Long Context LLM Inference
selection_reason: PMKS explicitly tiers KV state across GPU VRAM, host RAM, local NVMe SSD and RDMA-connected remote storage with asynchronous predictive prefetch, directly extending hierarchical-memory and storage-backed long-context inference lineages.
